frame: 0-1 minimap frame, same as the atlas: origin top-left, u to the right (west to east), v down (north to south); positions are team-normalized, own spawn at the bottom (bottom-left on Okinawa). Shapes: circle (u, v, r), ellipse, polygon (points), cells (grid cell names plus centre u, v).
mode_rule: top6 = the share of Top 6 smokes (of that kind on that map) in the spot is clearly higher than the Rest share (95% interval by resampling clans excludes zero); otherwise shared.
small_n: n 8 to 14 is small n; no spot has fewer than 8 smokes except where a record says so in its note.
